stem_md: $L$ 为圆 $(x-a)^2+y^2=a^2$ 与 $x$ 轴围成的第一象限区域边界（逆时针），计算 $\oint_Lxy\,dx$。
analysis_md:
解：

$$
\begin{aligned}
\oint_Lxy\,\mathrm{d}x&=\left(\int_{OA}+\int_{AO}\right)xy\,\mathrm{d}x，\quad\text{其中 }OA:\left\{\begin{aligned}x&=x\\y&=0\end{aligned}\right.，\quad x:0\to2a，\\
AO&:\left\{\begin{aligned}x&=a+a\cos\theta\\y&=a\sin\theta\end{aligned}\right.，\quad\theta:0\to\pi
\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\int_{OA}xy\,\mathrm{d}x=\int_0^{2a}x\times0\,\mathrm{d}x=0
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}
\int_{AO}xy\,\mathrm{d}x&=\int_0^\pi(a+a\cos\theta)a\sin\theta\,\mathrm{d}(a+a\cos\theta)\\
&=-a^3\int_0^\pi(\sin^2\theta+\sin^2\theta\cos\theta)\,\mathrm{d}\theta\\
&=-a^3\left[2\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\sin^2\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta+\int_0^\pi\sin^2\theta\cos\theta\,\mathrm{d}\theta\right]\\
&=-a^3\left(\frac{\pi}{2}+0\right)=-\frac{\pi a^3}{2}
\end{aligned}
$$

故

$$
\oint_Lxy\,\mathrm{d}x=0+\left(-\frac{\pi a^3}{2}\right)=-\frac{\pi a^3}{2}
$$
